scope: Publish and enforce strict response contracts for the private crop simulation run list and run-detail routes.

contract: Strict nested allowlist for run identifiers, names, timestamps, duration, yield, water, nitrogen, and soil carbon.
Strict counts and request-bound location, limit, and offset.
The page length and has_more flag must agree with total_runs, requested page size, and the 10,000 next-offset ceiling.
Strict nested run and daily-state allowlists aligned with the SELECT projection and schema.
Raw run parameters, configuration, metadata, errors, cost/revenue/margin, and state IDs remain excluded.
The response must match requested location, run, limit, and offset; page length and has_more must agree with total_states and the 10,000 next-offset ceiling.

error_behavior: Existing OIDC-disabled, tenant-denial, invalid-input, not-found, and sanitized database errors are preserved. Malformed successful projections return a generic no-store 500 with Vary: Cookie.
limitations: These tests validate response schema and fake-backed route behavior; they do not establish populated-data parity, live OIDC/browser behavior, or agronomic correctness.
Continuation is intentionally not advertised when a full next page would begin beyond the supported 10,000 offset ceiling.
